verdict.rationale: Overage behavior for automation and API limits is a fair question for a SaaS work-management platform, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence documents what happens on exceeding plan automation or API call limits: no extra charges, throttling, rate-limit errors or hard stops. The ability to 'track AI credit spend' is an adjacent monitoring feature, not documentation of overage consequences.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I know what happens—extra charges, throttling, or a hard stop—when I exceed my plan's automation or API call limits
